title: The Model Market (courses/<id>/market.json)
description: Prices, refunds, the board rule's numbers, stamps, course quotes, jobs, Gilda's lines and the other stalls' keepers'. docs/content-data.md, docs/specs/MODEL-MARKET.md.

picksInOrder.description: The hire's picks show in their own order (a scale from small to large), not shuffled like a quiz's answers.

categories.description: The course's model categories (models.json names them), smallest (cheapest) to largest: the boards' order and their size marks, each bound to a size the grading reads.

id.description: The category's name, as models.json writes it.

acts.description: The game's model size the grading reads for it (each once): on a quick look any size on its default effort is right-sized (small at the fair price); a hard job wants large, or medium on high effort (small falls short).

price.description: Starfish to hire a model of this category.

size.description: Read out for the size mark ("Small model").

tagline.description: The line under the category on the overlay's board.

efforts.description: The effort dial, low to high (the grading reads them in this order).

price.description: Starfish added to the model's price.

house.description: The house special: the app's own pick, sold beside the models (Copilot Fusion in the Copilot app course), with its own effort levels. Its first level is its base: right-sized for a quick look and short of a hard job; a higher level overspends on a quick look and is right-sized for a hard job.

price.description: Starfish for the house special at its base level.

levels.description: Its effort levels, lowest first (the first is its base). Saved in players' progress: don't rename a level's id.

price.description: Starfish added to the house special's price.

maxPrice.description: No hire costs more than this (at most 4).

perFamily.description: At most this many of one family (Claude, GPT, MAI) before the board fills up.

stamps.description: The stamp on the work order for each outcome.

quotes.description: Course sentences, word for word. The keys the grading and the work order use (cost, effort, hard, noGuarantee, auto, autoAside, autoLevels, autoMore, retry, noSpecific, vary) must stay.

jobs.description: Gilda's jobs board, in order (keys 1-4; the cork board has four spots).

id.description: Saved in players' progress: don't rename a job's id.

note.description: The note pinned on the cork board (short).

brief.description: One line about the job, from the course's own tasks.

why.description: A key of `quotes`: what the course says about a job like this.

gilda.description: Gilda's voiced lines (Port Meridian's stall). The grading and the puzzle use every key: `right` is for a right-sized hire with starfish back, `fair` for one at the fair price (nothing back), `keep` for a quick look right-sized with a bigger model on its default (or low) effort, `auto` when you pick the house special, `overAuto` for a quick look with the house special above its first level, `hardAuto` for a hard job right-sized with the house special above its first level, `early` for the counter before the course's model lesson, and `practiced` (hers alone) for the lesson's practice done.

practiced.description: Gilda's only: when the course's model lesson's practice (`lesson.practice` in puzzles/market.json) is done at her counter.

keepers.description: The other stalls' keepers (the game's stalls, src/game/market/stalls.ts), by the stall's island: each keeper's own voiced version of every line Gilda says (the same keys, the same teaching and its `source`, in their own words, never naming Gilda or her stall), and a goodbye. The line's speaker in voice/lines.json is the keeper's name.

refund.description: Starfish back for a right-sized hire with a model (the house special's is at most its price less one). Less than the cheapest right-sized model hire for the size (a right-sized job costs at least 1); the game also never refunds a hire's whole price.

doubloons.description: Doubloons the first time the job's done right-sized.

quotes.description: Keys of `quotes` shown on every work order of this size, after the job's own `why`.

anchor.description: The section's README anchor (the pack's lock.json).

hash.description: The section's hash from `npm run course:refs -- <NN>`.

text.description: Exactly as the course writes it, **bold** included.

voice.description: The voice line's id in the pack's voice/lines.json.

text.description: The voice line's text, word for word (the caption).

source.description: The course section a teaching line paraphrases.
